items.question: After interviewing five candidates for the sales position, the manager ---- the most experienced one.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“chose”代入题干后为“After interviewing five candidates for the sales position, the manager chose the most experienced one.”。选择理由：该项同时满足句法结构、固定搭配和句意要求，其余选项至少有一项不符。正确答案：C（chose）。
